items.claim: Menu-bar title gets the 16px end padding meant for a menu row's label
Access letter not underlined when it starts a cluster of more than one code point, such as कि or 👍🏽
Panel placed once at mount, so it overflows the viewport when a row widens it and the controller keeps a stale rect
Panel placed and sized once, so a row that grows pushes it past the viewport
items.note: duplicate of the A placement finding, fixed by 5623a5adca

items.claim: Text row's draft lost when the menu closes other than through useDismiss
items.note: The same gap was there for number rows (`UnitField` drafts), and the same commit fixes those. Blurring the field at teardown can't work, because React ignores DOM events during commit. Each value row now registers its draft with the open menu, which commits them before it disposes its controller.

items.claim: Silently opened trigger menu leaves focus on the body when dismissed while one of its fields has focus
items.note: useDismiss now blurs the field after `close` runs, not before.

items.claim: useContextMenu treated keyboard-raised context menus as pointer menus
Space did nothing on a color, number or text row
items.note: A click anywhere on a value row now also focuses its field, as Enter does.

items.claim: AccessLabel never underlined a final sigma
A menu taller than the viewport could not be scrolled, and the highlighted row ran off screen
items.note: This also moves HistoryList's scroll-into-box code into a shared `revealInBox`, used by both.

items.claim: A modified release opened a link with `window.open` and no `noopener`
A release over a color row didn't open its picker, and over a text or number row didn't focus its field
A text or number draft was lost when an outside press or a window blur closed the menu
A silently opened trigger menu dropped focus to `<body>` when it closed from inside the color picker
Enter on the picker's native color input pulled focus to the panel, so the menu closed while picking
